reporting-org.narrative: European Bank for Reconstruction and Development

description.narrative: The provision of a senior unsecured loan of up to US$ 80m to Khan Bank JSC, under the GCF GEFF Regional Framework. Out this amount, up to US$ 60m will be provided by EBRD and up to US$ 20m will be provided by the Green Climate Fund (GCF). The GEFF loan will be granted in two equal tranches, of which the second will be uncommitted. The GEFF loan will enable the Company to diversify its funding base and provide long term financing to private clients in Mongolia for investments in climate change mitigation and adaption technologies and services, in a gender-responsive way, thus contributing to Green Economy Transition.
